Medium muscular neck, short straight taut back, chest to elbows, slightly flat ribs and tucked belly. Four complete vertical strong limbs with lean hocks and rounded compact paws. Exact intense solid black coat, elastic dense shaggy wavy-curly tufts averaging4–7cm, strong not coarse topcoat and soft undercoat; eyes/foreface free of long hair. No grey/white/fawn or tan-point substitution, cords, smooth coat, floorlength furnishing or rounded Puli head. Full high-set natural tail forms a wide circle above croup, wiry7–12cm underside hairs standing apart, complete free endpoint distinct from back furnishings; no stump or docking.
